texts.text: I lost my job two months ago and I am behind on my credit card bills. My wife had surgery and we need help to catch up.
I have worked as a nurse at the same hospital for eleven years. I want to pay off two credit cards at a lower rate. My budget leaves $600 a month for this payment and I plan to finish in three years.
I am opening a second location for my bakery and need funds for equipment and the first months of rent.
Работаю инженером на одном заводе девять лет. Хочу закрыть две кредитные карты одним платежом по более низкой ставке. Из зарплаты могу отдавать 40 тысяч в месяц и планирую расплатиться за три года.

profiles.desc: Pay off High interest credit cards. Have been current on all my payments. I want one simple payment once a month and this gives me the opportunity to do so.

Our house is 14 years old. It needs new HVAC, new carpet, and refinished floors, as we may sell it within a short time. Even if we do not sell, the updates need to be made in order for the property to maintain its value.
Hello. I have requested $30,000 to refinance 4 credit cards that have an interest rate of 14% or higher and would like to pay them off quickly. Thank you.

Hello, Unfortunately I have a few credit cards with the average interest rate of 27 - 31% and 2 unsecured loans that are at 30% interest and am truly in need of a lower rate! Currently I do have a loan thru Lendg Clb and have never been late on pymt - would like to get lower too. consolidation

I currently have a loan that has a high interest rate and I am looking for a lower rate. I have a steady job, and I have payed off my credit cards over the last year and would like to do the same with this loan, which is my final debt to pay off. I see the light at the end of the tunnel.
Looking to consolidate several high interest loans/accounts and have only one monthly payment verses several. This will help me become debt free and financially independent.
I have used credit cards to keep my business going and now that it is working on its own I want to consolidate the debt with a fixed payment plan to pay off the debt.

I want to pay of all credit cards and my auto loan to consolidate into 1 payment per month only. In addition, having all accounts paid in full to increase my credit score. Lastly, I badly need to re roof my house before spring storms.

I want to be debt free, and feel this is a good way to do so, by paying off all credit cards and accounts. This loan will set a time limit for that to occur and I would be paying less each month, and it will give me the chance to pay it off even faster.

I started a great new job that has good benefits, however, I cannot come into them for another few months. I had surgery last year and am supposed to go for routine checkups and haven't been able to because of funds. This loan would be used towards doctor's visits.

I am trying to pay off debt and have one monthly payment rather than have ten or more to pay every month. I am trying to consolidate debt in one monthly payment rather than have to pay ten different companies and pay interest on more than ten different bills. It is much simpler to have one payment than at least ten. It is so hard to keep up with this many different bills to pay.
This loan is to get a fixed payment and eliminate the high interest credit card payment I currently have. My goal is to cancel these credit cards stick to one payment and get out of debt.
